clues: This big city sits on a ridge rich in gold and other minerals. For long years it has stood at the heart of the world gold trade.
In summer, the sun's rays here rate as extreme, near the top of the harm scale. The city's high land and its spot just south of the tropics make them so.
This city was born in 1886, right after gold was found on farm land here. That one find turned plain farms into a booming city.
In 1976, school pupils in this city's vast south-west township marched in protest. Their peaceful march was met with brutal force, and the day shook the whole land.
The biggest stock mart in Africa trades here. No town on the continent has more wealth in trade or in gold.
